description: This file defines the Google provider class for OAuth2 authentication within the League\OAuth2\Client library. It manages URLs, scopes, and parameters for Google OAuth2 interactions, and includes methods for response validation and resource owner creation.

classes.name: Google
classes.description: OAuth2 provider class for Google, extending AbstractProvider, handling OAuth URLs, scopes, and response processing.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL used for the initial authorization request to Google.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL used to obtain an access token from Google.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to retrieve user info using an access token.

methods.name: getAuthorizationParameters
methods.description: Generates authorization parameters including scope and optional parameters, ensuring default scopes are included.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Provides default OAuth2 scopes required by Google.

methods.name: getScopeSeparator
methods.description: Returns the separator for scopes, which is a space.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Validates the response from Google, throwing exceptions for errors.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates a GoogleUser resource owner from response data.

methods.name: assertMatchingDomain
methods.description: Ensures the hosted domain in the token matches the expected domain, throwing an exception if not.
